items.q: Do babies attach only to whoever feeds them?
items.correct: No — comfort and responsiveness matter more than feeding.
items.misconception: Yes, attachment forms only with the feeder.
items.random_wrong: Attachment cannot form in the first year of life.
items.why: Harlow and Schaffer showed responsiveness and contact comfort drive attachment, not just food.

items.q: Can early attachment affect later relationships?
items.correct: Yes — early attachment can act as a template for later relationships.
items.misconception: No, early experiences have no later effect.
items.why: Internal working models from early attachment can influence (not fix) later relationships.
